design_philosophy: Swiss & High-Contrast Archetype (Dark Mode). Strict, minimal, modern SaaS design. Absolute focus on typography, solid colors, and optical balance. Zero gradients allowed.

headings.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter leading-tight font-medium
headings.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight leading-snug font-medium

rules: NEVER use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings. Space Grotesk is forbidden.
Always apply tracking-tight or tracking-tighter to headings.
Labels must be uppercase with wide tracking (tracking-[0.2em]).
DO NOT USE GRADIENTS ANYWHERE. Strictly use solid colors.
Never use pure black (#000000) or pure white (#FFFFFF). Use off-white for text and tinted obsidian for backgrounds.
Limit the use of the primary color only to main call-to-actions (CTAs) and active states.

shadows: Use soft, ambient shadows. Example: shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.4)] for dropdowns and floating action bars.
Never use colored shadows or heavy drop shadows on text.
borders: Use 1px solid borders with #262626 (border-neutral-800) for structural division.
Cardless or minimal cards: heavily rely on subtle borders rather than background color changes.
radii: Nested radii must follow: child radius = parent radius - padding.
surfaces: Solid backgrounds only. For sticky headers or dropdowns over content, use solid #141414 with a 1px border. DO NOT use transparent or glassmorphism if it compromises readability over solid blocks.

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-6, p-8, or p-12 inside cards. Avoid p-4 unless space is highly constrained.

page_structure.header: Sticky top, solid background (#0A0A0A), bottom border 1px solid #262626. Includes App Name 'ResumeMatch AI' and a subtle subtitle 'Optimize your resume for any job in seconds'.
page_structure.main_grid: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-8 lg:gap-12 px-6 lg:px-12 py-8
page_structure.action_bar: Solid dark panel (#141414) fixed at the bottom or placed clearly below the 2-column grid, featuring the Primary 'Analyze Resume' button, Secondary 'Optimize Resume' button, and a modern switch/toggle for 'Aggressive Optimization'.
page_structure.results_dashboard: Wide, unified layout below the fold or on a new screen. Uses horizontal Shadcn Tabs for Overview, Gap Analysis, Missing Skills, Improvements, Optimized Resume, and Before vs After.

alignment: Left-align dense text, paragraphs, labels, and lists.
Center-align the main empty state/loading state messages for dramatic focus.

rules: Use Shadcn UI for logic and accessibility, but override the default Tailwind styles to match the custom colors and radii.
Never use raw HTML <select> or <input type='date'>. Use Shadcn select and calendar components.

specific_components.buttons: Pill-shaped or slightly rounded (4px). Primary is solid #2563EB, secondary is solid #262626. Add a slight transform hover effect (-translate-y-[1px]).
specific_components.inputs_and_textareas: Solid dark background (#0A0A0A), 1px solid #262626, focus:border-[#2563EB]. Text color #F5F5F5.
specific_components.file_upload_zone: Dashed border (border-dashed border-2 border-neutral-700), bg-neutral-900/50 hover:bg-neutral-800 transition-colors. Center aligned content.
specific_components.tabs: Shadcn tabs. Remove generic gray backgrounds. Use a clean underline style or solid active pill for the active tab, and muted text for inactive.
specific_components.tables: For Gap Analysis. Border-collapse, left-aligned headers, 1px bottom border on rows. No alternating background colors.
specific_components.badges_tags: For Missing Skills. Solid backgrounds using status colors at 15% opacity with solid text color (e.g., bg-red-900/30 text-red-400) for High/Med/Optional grouping.
specific_components.progress_charts: For ATS score. Use solid stroke SVGs. Color coded (Green > 80, Yellow 60-80, Red < 60).

rules: Minimalist animations. Use framer-motion for smooth entrance transitions.
List items (Missing skills, improvements) should stagger in.
Hover states must instantly provide feedback (transform or color shift).
DO NOT use 'transition: all'. Explicitly define properties (e.g., 'transition-colors duration-200').
motion.loading_states: Typographic focus. 'Parsing resume...', 'Analyzing job match...', 'Optimizing resume...' fading in and out cleanly in the center of the screen with a solid color progress bar or spinner.

media.icons: Use lucide-react (default) or @phosphor-icons/react. Keep stroke weights consistent (1.5px to 2px).

login_background.description: A sleek workspace featuring a wireless mouse and keyboard on a dark wooden desk, captured with natural lighting. Best used for the Login/Signup page split-screen background.

empty_state_graphic.description: Abstract dark lines. Best used subtly in an empty state or loading overlay if a visual is absolutely required.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text. Hover states must be higher contrast.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have a visible focus ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-offset-background).
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='upload-resume-dropzone').

instructions_to_main_agent: Read and apply all custom utility classes or inline styles explicitly replacing defaults with the exact color hexes or Tailwind neutral scales mapped to them.
Prioritize Shadcn component generation (Tabs, Table, Progress, Switch, Button, Input) but strip away Vercel-like gloss/gradients.
Implement the Layout strictly: A sticky header, a 2-column input section (left upload, right job description), a fixed/distinct Action Bar, and a large Tabbed Results section below.
For the ATS Score, ensure the numeric value is large (e.g., text-6xl) and color-coded strictly using the solid status colors.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and subtle solid borders.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., `transition: all`). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the CSS file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use real SVG icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
Use `sonner` for toasts. Sonner component is located in `/app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx` or similar path depending on your setup.
